title: Politiki y'ibanga
description: Amakuru I Need Save itunganya iyo ukoresha uru rubuga, cookies n'ibikoresho by'isesengura ikoresha, n'uburenganzira ufite ku makuru yawe bwite.
body:
I Need Save (ineedsave.com) ni igikoresho cy'ubuntu cyo gukuramo videwo, amafoto n'amajwi ku mbuga nkoranyambaga, gicungwa na Abid Hanan Wicaksono. Iyi politiki isobanura amakuru dutunganya iyo ukoresha uru rubuga n'uko tuyafata. Tubigambiriye, dukusanya amakuru make cyane ashoboka: ntukeneye kwiyandikisha, kwinjira, cyangwa gutanga izina ryawe cyangwa imeyili yawe kugira ngo ukoreshe serivisi.

Amakuru dutunganya

  • Link womeka. Link yoherezwa kuri seriveri yacu gusa kugira ngo hashakishwe videwo, amafoto cyangwa amajwi bishobora gukurwamo. Ntitubika link mu bubiko bw'amakuru (database) kandi ntituzihuza n'umwirondoro wawe.
  • Amadosiye ya videwo, amafoto n'amajwi. Igihe cyose bishoboka, mushakisha (browser) yawe ikuramo dosiye mu buryo butaziguye kuri seriveri z'urubuga rw'umwimerere (urugero Instagram, Facebook, cyangwa X). Iyo dosiye igomba gutunganywa (urugero, guhuza videwo n'amajwi cyangwa kuyihindura MP3), cyangwa iyo urubuga rutemera gukuramo mu buryo butaziguye, inyuzwa kuri seriveri yacu igana ku gikoresho cyawe itabitswe.
  • Amakuru ya tekiniki. Nk'uko bimeze ku mbuga hafi ya zose, utanga serivisi yo kwakira urubuga rwacu (Vercel) yandika amakuru ya tekiniki y'ibisabwa, nka aderesi ya IP, ubwoko bwa mushakisha n'igihe cyo kwinjira, hagamijwe umutekano n'imikorere. Izi nyandiko zibikwa by'igihe gito gusa hakurikijwe politiki za Vercel.
  • Imibare y'inyandiko. Umubare w'abarebye, abakunze n'abasangije ubikwa nk'igiteranyo kuri buri nyandiko, nta makuru akuranga arimo.

Cookies n'ububiko bwa mushakisha

  • ins-lang: yibuka ururimi wahisemo, mu gihe cy'umwaka umwe.
  • dl_…: cookie y'igihe gito imara amasegonda make, igaragaza ko gukuramo byatangiye.
  • Ububiko bwo ku gikoresho (localStorage na sessionStorage): bwibuka inyandiko wakunze kandi bukabuza ko gusura kumwe kubarwa kabiri. Aya makuru aguma ku gikoresho cyawe.
  • Cookies z'isesengura z'ibigo byo hanze za Google Analytics na Microsoft Clarity, zisobanuwe hepfo.

Isesengura

Dukoresha ibikoresho by'isesengura kugira ngo twumve uko urubuga rukoreshwa no kurunoza:

  • Vercel Web Analytics: imibare y'abasura itagaragaza abo ari bo, idakoresha cookies.
  • Google Analytics 4 (Google LLC): ikoresha cookies mu gupima paji ufungura, igihugu urimo mu buryo bwegereye, ubwoko bw'igikoresho cyawe, n'ibikorwa nko gukanda kuri buto zo gukuramo. Amakuru atunganywa na Google hakurikijwe Politiki y'Ibanga ya Google.
  • Microsoft Clarity: itangira gukora iyo utangiye gukoresha paji. Clarity yandika ibikorwa nko gukanda no kumanura paji (scroll) kugira ngo hakorwe amakarita y'ubushyuhe (heatmaps) n'amashusho y'uko paji yakoreshejwe (session recordings), kandi ihisha ibyo wandika mu myanya yo kwandikamo. Amakuru atunganywa na Microsoft hakurikijwe Itangazo rya Microsoft ryerekeye Ibanga.

Ushobora kwanga isesengura ubuza cookies z'ibigo byo hanze mu igenamiterere rya mushakisha yawe, ukoresha igikoresho kibuza ikurikiranwa (tracker blocker), cyangwa ushyiraho Google Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on. Urubuga rukomeza gukoreshwa byuzuye.

Serivisi z'ibigo byo hanze

  • Vercel Inc. itanga serivisi yo kwakira urubuga (hosting). Seriveri zayo zishobora kuba ziri hanze y'igihugu cyawe.
  • Google Fonts ikoreshwa mu kugaragaza zimwe mu nyuguti (urugero iz'Icyarabu, Igitayi, cyangwa Ikiyapani). Iyo imyandikire (font) ifunguka, aderesi yawe ya IP igaragara kuri Google.
  • Urubuga rw'umwimerere rw'ibikubiyemo. Iyo dosiye ikuwemo mu buryo butaziguye, urwo rubuga rushobora kubona aderesi yawe ya IP, nk'uko bimeze iyo wifunguriye ibikubiyemo ubwawe.
  • Buto zo gusangiza (WhatsApp, Facebook, X, LinkedIn, Telegram) zivugana n'izo serivisi gusa iyo uzikanzeho.

Umutekano no gusangiza amakuru

Imihuza yose kuri uru rubuga ikoresha HTTPS. Ntitugurisha, ntidukodesha, kandi ntiducuruza amakuru bwite. Amakuru asangizwa gusa abatanga serivisi bavuzwe haruguru, mu rugero rukenewe kugira ngo urubuga rukore, cyangwa iyo bisabwa n'amategeko.

Abana

Iyi serivisi ntigenewe abana bari munsi y'imyaka 13, kandi ntidukusanya tubizi amakuru bwite y'abana.

Uburenganzira bwawe

Bitewe n'aho utuye (urugero hakurikijwe Itegeko rya Indoneziya ryerekeye kurinda amakuru bwite, Itegeko No. 27 ryo mu 2022, cyangwa GDPR y'Ubumwe bw'u Burayi), ushobora kugira uburenganzira bwo kubona, gukosora, cyangwa gusiba amakuru yawe bwite no kwisubiraho ku ruhushya watanze rwo kuyatunganya. Kubera ko tutabika hafi na gato amakuru akuranga, ibyifuzo byinshi bishobora gukemurwa mu buryo bworoshye usiba cookies muri mushakisha yawe. Ku makuru atunganywa na Google cyangwa Microsoft, ushobora kandi gukoresha igenamiterere ry'ibanga rya serivisi zabo. Ku kindi kintu cyose, twandikire.

Impinduka kuri iyi politiki

Iyi politiki ishobora kuvugururwa rimwe na rimwe. Impinduka zitangira gukurikizwa iyo zitangajwe kuri iyi paji, itariki zitangiriraho gukurikizwa ikagaragazwa hejuru.

Twandikire

Ibibazo byerekeye iyi politiki bishobora koherezwa binyuze kuri link zo kutwandikira ziri hasi kuri buri paji cyangwa kuri abidhanan.my.id.
